tab_descriptions.effects: Choose the visual animation played when visitors switch between light and dark themes.
tab_descriptions.effects_info: Only the active effect's JavaScript chunk is lazy-loaded by visitors. Click any card to select it, or press play to preview live.
tab_descriptions.customization: Fine-tune animation duration, timing curves, and effect-specific motion parameters.
tab_descriptions.settings: Control where transitions run and how accessibility and mobile preferences are handled.
tab_descriptions.settings_info: Theme Transitions hooks into Flarum 2's app.setColorScheme() on user interactions while keeping page loads and OS prefers-color-scheme changes instant. Unsupported browsers fall back cleanly.
tab_descriptions.integrations: Works seamlessly with Flarum 2's core Theme Switcher, Appearance settings, and companion theme extensions.
tab_descriptions.integrations_info: Any extension that switches themes through Flarum 2's app.setColorScheme() automatically inherits your configured transition effect and trigger coordinates.

simple_dark_mode.title: Simple Dark Mode
simple_dark_mode.description: Adds a one-click dark/light theme toggle button right in the forum header for guests and members. Clicking the toggle triggers your configured Theme Transitions animation directly from the button's position.
simple_dark_mode.active_note: Detected and active on this forum. Header toggle clicks automatically trigger your selected transition effect.
simple_dark_mode.disabled_note: Installed on this forum, but currently disabled. Enable it to add a one-click header theme toggle paired with Theme Transitions.
simple_dark_mode.install_note: Not installed yet. Install via Composer to give guests and members a quick header toggle animated by Theme Transitions.

preview.title: Live Transition Preview
preview.help: Tests your current draft configuration right on this page without changing your saved user theme preference.

validation.invalid_easing: Invalid curve (Telegram fallback will be used)

circle.name: Circle Reveal (Telegram)
circle.description: Expands the new theme outward in a crisp circle from the clicked toggle.

circle-shrink.name: Circle Shrink
circle-shrink.description: Collapses the previous theme inward toward the trigger point.

circle-blur.name: Circle Blur
circle-blur.description: Soft-edged circular reveal paired with a subtle optical blur.

wipe.name: Directional Wipe
wipe.description: Sweeps cleanly across the viewport from a chosen edge.

diagonal.name: Diagonal Sweep
diagonal.description: Cuts diagonally from corner to corner at a 45° angle.

split.name: Split Curtain
split.description: Opens outward from the center like dual curtains.

diamond.name: Diamond Burst
diamond.description: Expands as a sharp rotated diamond from the origin.

iris.name: Camera Iris
iris.description: Octagonal shutter reveal with a subtle aperture twist.

blinds.name: Venetian Blinds
blinds.description: Reveals the new theme across synchronized multi-slat strips.

fade.name: Smooth Crossfade
fade.description: Clean, minimal opacity dissolve with zero spatial movement.

blur.name: Blur Dissolve
blur.description: Crossfades through a gentle Gaussian blur transition.

zoom.name: Focal Zoom
zoom.description: Subtle scale and opacity transition anchored at the origin.

slide.name: Parallax Slide
slide.description: Slides the new theme in while pushing the old theme softly aside.

flip.name: 3D Card Flip
flip.description: Rotates the viewport in 3D perspective between themes.

settings.enabled_help: Animate user-initiated color scheme switches across the forum using the View Transitions API.
settings.effect_help: Only the active effect's JavaScript chunk is lazy-loaded by visitors.
settings.duration_help: Total length of the theme transition animation between 100 ms and 2000 ms.
settings.easing_help: Controls the acceleration profile of the transition.
settings.custom_easing_help: Enter a CSS timing keyword or cubic-bezier(x1, y1, x2, y2) with x1 and x2 between 0 and 1.
settings.origin_help: Where radial, diamond, iris, and zoom effects originate from.
settings.direction_help: Controls the axis and direction for directional effects.
settings.reverse_mode_help: Optionally invert the transition direction depending on dark/light polarity.
settings.blinds_count_help: Number of synchronized strips rendered by the Venetian Blinds effect (3–24).
settings.blur_amount_help: Maximum blur radius applied during blur-based effects (2–32 px).
settings.enable_admin_help: Animate color scheme switches inside the Flarum admin dashboard as well.
settings.disable_on_mobile_label: Disable animations on mobile / touch devices
settings.disable_on_mobile_help: Skip View Transitions on coarse-pointer or small-screen devices for instant switching.
settings.respect_reduced_motion_help: Automatically disable animations for visitors who prefer reduced motion at the OS/browser level.
